The '''Impeding Assault Tank''' ('''IAT'''), more commonly known as the '''Umbaran crawler tank''', was a caterpillar-like ground vehicle developed by the [[Umbaran militia]].

==Description==
The IAT was a [[Ray shield/Legends|shielded]] machine<ref name="encyclopedia" /> that could be [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by a single [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]].<ref name="general" /> It was armed with [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]]&mdash;four at the front and two at the rear, while ten covered the segmented bodies.<ref name="encyclopedia" />

==History==
[[File:UmbaranCrawlerTank-BattleOfUmbara.png|thumb|left|250px|An Impeding Assault Tank attacks the 501st Legion during the Battle of Umbara.]]
The only action the IAT had experienced was during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]] between the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Umbaran militia]] that had sided with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. As the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] patrolled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of Umbara, one IAT suddenly sprang out from under the ground, catching many clones off-guard. Following the arrival of additional crawler tanks, the Republic forces used [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launchers]] and [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] to destroy the vehicles.<ref name="general">{{TCW|The General (episode)}}</ref>
